frigate.compose.yml.tmpl:
# Frigate NVR (add-on "frigate", rendered by synofurb-mgmt). Do not edit by hand: it is rewritten on install and update.
# Official image and layout: https://docs.frigate.video/frigate/installation (checked 2026-11-03, Frigate 0.18.2).
services:
  frigate:
    container_name: synofurb-frigate
    image: ghcr.io/blakeblackshear/frigate:stable
    restart: unless-stopped
    stop_grace_period: 30s
    shm_size: "${shm_mb}mb"
    environment:
      TZ: "${TZ}"
    volumes:
      - /etc/localtime:/etc/localtime:ro
      - ${DATA_DIR}/config:/config
      - ${STORAGE_MEDIA}:/media/frigate
    tmpfs:
      - /tmp/cache:size=${cache_mb}m
    ports:
      - "8971:8971"
      - "127.0.0.1:5000:5000"
      - "8554:8554"
      - "8555:8555/tcp"
      - "8555:8555/udp"
    logging:
      driver: json-file
      options:
        max-size: "20m"
        max-file: "5"
${DEVICES_BLOCK}
frigate.config.yml.tmpl:
# Frigate configuration, rendered ONCE by synofurb-mgmt when the add-on is installed (never overwritten afterwards).
# From here on this file belongs to you: edit it here or in Frigate's Settings. Reference:
# https://docs.frigate.video/configuration/advanced/reference
#
# Cameras: camera_1 .. camera_4 are slots. A slot is off (enabled: False) until you give it a stream in the add-on settings
# or edit it here. Streams go through go2rtc (restream), so every camera is read once and shared by detect, record and live view.

mqtt:
  enabled: False

${DETECTOR_BLOCK}${MODEL_BLOCK}
ffmpeg:
  hwaccel_args: ${hwaccel}

record:
  enabled: True
  continuous:
    days: ${retain_days}
  alerts:
    retain:
      days: ${event_retain_days}
  detections:
    retain:
      days: ${event_retain_days}

snapshots:
  enabled: True
  retain:
    default: ${event_retain_days}

go2rtc:
  streams:
    camera_1:
      - "${cam1_url}"
    camera_2:
      - "${cam2_url}"
    camera_3:
      - "${cam3_url}"
    camera_4:
      - "${cam4_url}"

cameras:
  camera_1:
    enabled: ${cam1_enabled}
    ffmpeg:
      inputs:
        - path: rtsp://127.0.0.1:8554/camera_1
          input_args: preset-rtsp-restream
          roles:
            - detect
            - record
  camera_2:
    enabled: ${cam2_enabled}
    ffmpeg:
      inputs:
        - path: rtsp://127.0.0.1:8554/camera_2
          input_args: preset-rtsp-restream
          roles:
            - detect
            - record
  camera_3:
    enabled: ${cam3_enabled}
    ffmpeg:
      inputs:
        - path: rtsp://127.0.0.1:8554/camera_3
          input_args: preset-rtsp-restream
          roles:
            - detect
            - record
  camera_4:
    enabled: ${cam4_enabled}
    ffmpeg:
      inputs:
        - path: rtsp://127.0.0.1:8554/camera_4
          input_args: preset-rtsp-restream
          roles:
            - detect
            - record

plex.compose.yml.tmpl:
# Plex Media Server (add-on "plex", rendered by synofurb-mgmt). Do not edit by hand: it is rewritten on install and update.
# Official image and parameters: https://github.com/plexinc/pms-docker (checked 2026-11-03).
services:
  plex:
    container_name: synofurb-plex
    image: plexinc/pms-docker:latest
    restart: unless-stopped
    environment:
      TZ: "${TZ}"
      PLEX_UID: "${PUID}"
      PLEX_GID: "${PGID}"
      PLEX_CLAIM: "${plex_claim}"
      ADVERTISE_IP: "${advertise_url}"
    volumes:
      - ${DATA_DIR}/config:/config
      - ${STORAGE_TRANSCODE}:/transcode
      - ${media_dir}:/data:${media_access}
${NETWORK_BLOCK}    logging:
      driver: json-file
      options:
        max-size: "20m"
        max-file: "3"
${DEVICES_BLOCK}

portainer.compose.yml.tmpl:
# Portainer CE (add-on "portainer", rendered by synofurb-mgmt). Do not edit by hand: it is rewritten on install and update.
# Image: portainer/portainer-ce:lts (the long-term-support release line).
services:
  portainer:
    container_name: synofurb-portainer
    image: portainer/portainer-ce:lts
    restart: unless-stopped
    environment:
      TZ: "${TZ}"
    ports:
      - "9443:9443"
    volumes:
      - /var/run/docker.sock:/var/run/docker.sock
      - ${DATA_DIR}/data:/data
    logging:
      driver: json-file
      options:
        max-size: "10m"
        max-file: "3"
